title: Plakar Immich Dump Exporter Connector Config

location.description: Immich server, immich+dump://host[:port][/prefix]; https unless the host is loopback or plaintext is set

api_key.description: Immich API key of an admin, one that exists in the dump when the server is fresh; PLAKAR_IMMICH_API_KEY in the environment takes precedence

maintenance_token.description: Maintenance token from the server log, needed on a server with no admin user yet; PLAKAR_IMMICH_MAINTENANCE_TOKEN in the environment takes precedence

upload_location.description: The server's UPLOAD_LOCATION on this host, where /upload_location is restored

force.description: Restore a dump whose Immich or Postgres version does not match the server

restore_timeout.description: How long to wait for the maintenance restore, as a Go duration

insecure.description: Do not verify the server's TLS certificate
